nodes.text: Is this what we're calling covid-19 now? It's going to be a long while, before we ever see a break in virus outbreaks. It's amazing to see in comments, the arrogance of people who will argue w/ others about viruses. Everyone that doesn't work w/ infectious diseases, acts like

nodes.author: KimberlyDawnRu1
nodes.text: experts on the subject. Everyone that didn't see or witness anyone that died from C19, seems to think C19 just vanished. 😳I watched someone die on a ventilator, that got covid-19. So in my heart, I know the virus never really left. The rest of people, that argue, go fuck off .
